entries.zh: 自由；不受拘束，任意而行（此指该法官行事自专）
entries.en: free, at liberty; (of a judge) acting at one's own will
entries.notes: L 为职名而 H 作「自由」，依本页官职条多以行为语对译之例，当指其行事自专。

entries.zh: 斩杀；斩首处死（指该官掌生杀之权）
entries.en: to behead, to execute; (of a judge) to put to death

entries.zh: 行法度；依法度行事、执法（形容法官公正）
entries.en: to administer the law; to act according to the statutes

entries.zh: 清廉；廉洁不贪
entries.en: honest and incorruptible; clean-handed

entries.zh: 贪酷；贪婪酷虐（收受贿赂而严酷榨取）
entries.en: greedy and cruel; rapacious and harsh (taking bribes and then extorting)

entries.zh: 具臣；备位之臣，此指王室议会中的参议／法官
entries.en: councillor of the royal council; (lit.) a minister who fills a place
entries.notes: H 首字有 [疑:具/贝]，M cū 合 具；具臣 本义为备位之臣，此指议会之臣。

entries.zh: 斩杀；掌生杀之权、得处决人犯
entries.en: to behead, to execute; to hold power of life and death

entries.zh: 曲曲；歪曲不正（形容法官糊涂，曲直颠倒）
entries.en: crooked, warped; (of a judge) muddled and unable to judge rightly
entries.notes: H 第三字 [疑:不/之]，M「yā quit」与 示直 对应不明；仅首二字 曲曲（不正）与 L「糊涂失断」可据。

entries.zh: 轩轩；气宇轩昂、英武有气概
entries.en: high-spirited and imposing; gallant, spirited

entries.zh: 赌；赌博、以财物为注
entries.en: to gamble; to play for stakes

entries.zh: 戏；嬉戏、娱乐之戏
entries.en: to play (a game of amusement); to sport
entries.notes: H 有 [疑:皆/戏]，M guàn 与 戏（hì）不合，义从 L「娱乐之戏」与 戏 字。

entries.zh: 戏耍；嬉戏玩笑
entries.en: to play, to sport; to joke, to trifle
entries.notes: M 首音节 T99 污损、L「bra tanto」残缺，仅 H 戏 可据。

entries.zh: 奕（弈）；下棋对弈（奕棋之戏）
entries.en: to play chess; to play a board game like chess

entries.zh: 舞盘；舞弄兵器、盘旋挥舞（演武、使弄刀枪）
entries.en: to brandish weapons; to practise arms with whirling flourishes
entries.notes: H 第三字 [疑:步/盘]，M 末音节作 pvā̃，合 盘 之读；L「舞弄兵器」与 舞盘 相合。

entries.zh: 赌钱；玩纸牌赌博、以赌赢财
entries.en: to play cards for money; to gamble at cards
entries.notes: [疑] 第二字 赚/钱 未决，M 末段 hòi pǒg 未能通读；义据 L「naipes（纸牌）」与 赌 字。

entries.zh: 赌荡；赌博挥霍、荡尽家财
entries.en: to gamble and squander; to dissipate one's fortune by gambling

entries.zh: 酒令；饮酒行令之戏（猜拳、猜枚一类助兴）
entries.en: drinking games; the wine-order game played at banquets

entries.zh: 猜拳；划拳（饮酒时猜手指之数以决胜负）
entries.en: to play morra; to play at finger-guessing
entries.notes: M 栏尾「iz jugar apara y nones」系西语说明（es jugar a pares y nones），非音写。

entries.zh: 猜枚；猜手中所藏物之数（酒席猜数之戏）
entries.en: to play 'guess the tally' (guessing the number of objects held in the fist)
entries.notes: H 首字录作 从[疑:从/终]，M chày būe 合 猜枚，据以定为 猜枚。

entries.zh: 灯猜；猜灯谜之戏（元宵张灯射谜一类）
entries.en: lantern-riddle guessing; a riddle-guessing game
entries.notes: H 次字 [疑:请/猜]，M tēng chày 合 灯猜；L 作猜奇偶，与灯谜之戏关联未明。
